config.label: Path to the grok executable
config.description: Path to the grok executable. Only needed when grok is not on PATH.

config.label: Highest permission level any call may request
config.description: Highest permission level any call may request. Granted once at registration and never prompts again.

config.label: Permission level used when a call specifies none
config.description: Permission level used when a call specifies none. Must be at or below the ceiling.

config.label: Model used when a call omits one
config.description: Model used when a call omits one.

config.label: Reasoning effort used when a call omits one
config.description: Reasoning effort used when a call omits one.

config.label: Wall-clock kill for a single run, in milliseconds
config.description: Wall-clock kill for a single run, in milliseconds.

config.label: Directory for background job records
config.description: Directory for background job records. Defaults to $XDG_STATE_HOME/grok-mcp.

config.label: Background runs alive at once
config.description: Background runs alive at once. Use off, none, or unlimited for no cap.

config.label: Emit structuredContent alongside _meta
config.description: Emit structuredContent alongside _meta. Off by default because some clients mishandle it.
